\section[(dialogue)]{Colours, size and place — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GU-R91-first-pass-colours-size-and-place}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an apology and okay.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a star, a parrot, a peacock, a sparrow, a fish
  \item red, yellow, green, blue, black
  \item white, brown, pink, beautiful, bad
  \item big, small, long, short, heavy
  \item light, new, old, hot, cheap
  \item expensive, near, far, up, down
  \item ahead, behind, inside, outside, between
  \item a lot, all, slowly, quickly, again
  \item always, sometimes, now, later, before
  \item Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday
  \item Saturday, Sunday, tomorrow, yesterday, time
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A star? (\textbf{\gu{તારો}}.) A parrot? (\textbf{\gu{પોપટ}}.) A peacock? (\textbf{\gu{મોર}}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{\gu{ચકલી}}.) A fish? (\textbf{\gu{માછલી}}.) Red? (\textbf{\gu{લાલ}}.) Yellow? (\textbf{\gu{પીળો}}.) Green? (\textbf{\gu{લીલો}}.) Blue? (\textbf{\gu{વાદળી}}.) Black? (\textbf{\gu{કાળો}}.) White? (\textbf{\gu{સફેદ}}.) Brown? (\textbf{\gu{ભૂરો}}.) Pink? (\textbf{\gu{ગુલાબી}}.) Beautiful? (\textbf{\gu{સુંદર}}.) Bad? (\textbf{\gu{ખરાબ}}.) Big? (\textbf{\gu{મોટું}}.) Small? (\textbf{\gu{નાનું}}.) Long? (\textbf{\gu{લાંબું}}.) Short? (\textbf{\gu{ટૂંકું}}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\gu{ભારે}}.) Light? (\textbf{\gu{હલકું}}.) New? (\textbf{\gu{નવું}}.) Old? (\textbf{\gu{જૂનું}}.) Hot? (\textbf{\gu{ગરમ}}.) Cheap? (\textbf{\gu{સસ્તું}}.) Expensive? (\textbf{\gu{મોંઘું}}.) Near? (\textbf{\gu{નજીક}}.) Far? (\textbf{\gu{દૂર}}.) Up? (\textbf{\gu{ઉપર}}.) Down? (\textbf{\gu{નીચે}}.) Ahead? (\textbf{\gu{આગળ}}.) Behind? (\textbf{\gu{પાછળ}}.) Inside? (\textbf{\gu{અંદર}}.) Outside? (\textbf{\gu{બહાર}}.) Between? (\textbf{\gu{વચ્ચે}}.) A lot? (\textbf{\gu{ઘણું}}.) All? (\textbf{\gu{બધું}}.) Slowly? (\textbf{\gu{ધીમે}}.) Quickly? (\textbf{\gu{જલદી}}.) Again? (\textbf{\gu{ફરી}}.) Always? (\textbf{\gu{હંમેશા}}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{\gu{ક્યારેક}}.) Now? (\textbf{\gu{હવે}}.) Later? (\textbf{\gu{પછી}}.) Before? (\textbf{\gu{પહેલાં}}.) Monday? (\textbf{\gu{સોમવાર}}.) Tuesday? (\textbf{\gu{મંગળવાર}}.) Wednesday? (\textbf{\gu{બુધવાર}}.) Thursday? (\textbf{\gu{ગુરુવાર}}.) Friday? (\textbf{\gu{શુક્રવાર}}.) Saturday? (\textbf{\gu{શનિવાર}}.) Sunday? (\textbf{\gu{રવિવાર}}.) Tomorrow? (\textbf{\gu{આવતીકાલ}}.) Yesterday? (\textbf{\gu{ગઈકાલ}}.) Time? (\textbf{\gu{સમય}}.)

\section[(dialogue)]{Time, numbers, town and people — a second pass}

\label{lesson:GU-R91-second-pass-time-numbers-town-and-people}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an hour and a minute.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an hour, a minute, a holiday, a festival, Holi
  \item eleven, twelve, thirteen, fifteen, sixteen
  \item seventeen, eighteen, twenty, thirty, forty
  \item fifty, a hundred, a thousand, how much, which one
  \item a clinic, a bank, the police, an open ground, a bridge
  \item a bus, a train, a station, an aeroplane, a port
  \item a journey, a ticket, a map, a phone, the post
  \item a dhoti, a shirt, sandals, a cap, an umbrella
  \item glasses, a bag, a wallet, a letter, a gift
  \item a student, a question, an answer, to study, to teach
  \item a wedding, a birthday, age, a field, a merchant
  \item welcome, congratulations, good wishes, an apology, okay
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An hour? (\textbf{\gu{કલાક}}.) A minute? (\textbf{\gu{મિનિટ}}.) A holiday? (\textbf{\gu{રજા}}.) A festival? (\textbf{\gu{તહેવાર}}.) Holi? (\textbf{\gu{હોળી}}.) Eleven? (\textbf{\gu{અગિયાર}}.) Twelve? (\textbf{\gu{બાર}}.) Thirteen? (\textbf{\gu{તેર}}.) Fifteen? (\textbf{\gu{પંદર}}.) Sixteen? (\textbf{\gu{સોળ}}.) Seventeen? (\textbf{\gu{સત્તર}}.) Eighteen? (\textbf{\gu{અઢાર}}.) Twenty? (\textbf{\gu{વીસ}}.) Thirty? (\textbf{\gu{ત્રીસ}}.) Forty? (\textbf{\gu{ચાળીસ}}.) Fifty? (\textbf{\gu{પચાસ}}.) A hundred? (\textbf{\gu{સો}}.) A thousand? (\textbf{\gu{હજાર}}.) How much? (\textbf{\gu{કેટલું}}.) Which one? (\textbf{\gu{કયું}}.) A clinic? (\textbf{\gu{દવાખાનું}}.) A bank? (\textbf{\gu{બેંક}}.) The police? (\textbf{\gu{પોલીસ}}.) An open ground? (\textbf{\gu{મેદાન}}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\gu{પુલ}}.) A bus? (\textbf{\gu{બસ}}.) A train? (\textbf{\gu{ટ્રેન}}.) A station? (\textbf{\gu{સ્ટેશન}}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{\gu{વિમાન}}.) A port? (\textbf{\gu{બંદર}}.) A journey? (\textbf{\gu{મુસાફરી}}.) A ticket? (\textbf{\gu{ટિકિટ}}.) A map? (\textbf{\gu{નકશો}}.) A phone? (\textbf{\gu{ફોન}}.) The post? (\textbf{\gu{ટપાલ}}.) A dhoti? (\textbf{\gu{ધોતી}}.) A shirt? (\textbf{\gu{ખમીસ}}.) Sandals? (\textbf{\gu{ચંપલ}}.) A cap? (\textbf{\gu{ટોપી}}.) An umbrella? (\textbf{\gu{છત્રી}}.) Glasses? (\textbf{\gu{ચશ્માં}}.) A bag? (\textbf{\gu{થેલી}}.) A wallet? (\textbf{\gu{પાકીટ}}.) A letter? (\textbf{\gu{પત્ર}}.) A gift? (\textbf{\gu{ભેટ}}.) A student? (\textbf{\gu{વિદ્યાર્થી}}.) A question? (\textbf{\gu{પ્રશ્ન}}.) An answer? (\textbf{\gu{જવાબ}}.) To study? (\textbf{\gu{ભણવું}}.) To teach? (\textbf{\gu{શીખવવું}}.) A wedding? (\textbf{\gu{લગ્ન}}.) A birthday? (\textbf{\gu{જન્મદિવસ}}.) Age? (\textbf{\gu{ઉંમર}}.) A field? (\textbf{\gu{ખેતર}}.) A merchant? (\textbf{\gu{વેપારી}}.) Welcome? (\textbf{\gu{સ્વાગત}}.) Congratulations? (\textbf{\gu{અભિનંદન}}.) Good wishes? (\textbf{\gu{શુભેચ્છા}}.) An apology? (\textbf{\gu{માફી}}.) Okay?
